subject: Overridding the alpha aesthetics in a legend

messages.author: 138dd9afe8fbc488
messages.subject: Overridding the alpha aesthetics in a legend
parts:
I have recently hit a situation where I have a series of segments with a very low alpha level (0.2) upon which I am plotting.  In addition to plotting several lines (from a MC) there are two major groupings of lines which I separated using the color aesthetic.  When ggplot fabricates the legend entries, the alpha level is carried to the legend entries which makes them invisible.  How does one set the alpha level on the legend entries so they show but maintain the alpha level for the actual drawn lines.

I saw the GitHub issue concerning this and asked there but was redirected to ask here.  The link for the issue is 

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/109#issuecomment-138368012

The example code I put there is:

-----
rp = ggplot(pd) + theme_bw() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = typen - 0.2, xend = typen + 0.05, y = low, yend = low, color = 'low'), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = typen - 0.05, xend = typen + 0.2, y = high, yend = high, color = 'high'), alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(name = 'Interval Edge', breaks = c('low', 'high'), values = c('red', 'green'), alpha = 1)
rp
-----

Thanks for any pointers.
